anyOf.description: An app by its folder, from host.yaml's folder (for example apps/clinic).

folder.description: The app's folder, the one with app.yaml, from host.yaml's folder (for example apps/clinic).

env.description: The app's own settings file, from host.yaml's folder. Default: .env in the app's folder. Only the variables the app's YAML names (env.<NAME>: its transfer targets, startParameters, called numbers) are read from it, for that app alone.

services.description: Where each of the app's downstream services (App.services, by name) is reached, as env.<NAME>: the variable, in the app's own settings file (else the server's), holds its URL. Default: none, so a service that needs a URL is answered with no result, as when a launcher starts none.

anyOf.description: An app by its folder, with its own settings file named.

package.description: An app installed as a package (for example "@acme/repairs-line"): its folder is the package's, found from host.yaml's folder as Node finds it. The package has app.yaml and app.ts (or src/app.ts), as an app folder has.

env.description: The app's own settings file, from host.yaml's folder. Default: .env in the app's folder. Only the variables the app's YAML names (env.<NAME>: its transfer targets, startParameters, called numbers) are read from it, for that app alone.

services.description: Where each of the app's downstream services (App.services, by name) is reached, as env.<NAME>: the variable, in the app's own settings file (else the server's), holds its URL. Default: none, so a service that needs a URL is answered with no result, as when a launcher starts none.

anyOf.description: An app installed as a package.

items.description: An app the server runs: its folder (a path), { folder, env }, or { package, env }.

apps.description: The apps this server runs, each known by the id its own app.yaml gives it. Each keeps its own folder, policy, prompts, tests, traces and audit.

numbers.description: The numbers callers dial, each pointing at an app by its id, as the carrier delivers the number called (the same matching as a `called` condition). Default: none, so every call goes to the default app.

number.description: The number callers dial, as env.<NAME>: the variable in the server's settings file holds it, an E.164 number like +15551234567.

app.description: The app a call to this number reaches: the id its app.yaml gives it.

items.description: One number callers dial and the app it reaches. Several numbers may name one app; a number listed twice is refused.

default.description: The app a call reaches when its number is listed nowhere (or the carrier sends none), and the web chat at /chat. Default: the first app listed.

description: Several apps on one server: the apps, the numbers that reach each, and the default.
